summary: Iteration 51 - Guest Satisfaction Survey Feature Tests. All 30 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend verified with all 4 tabs (Analytics, Responses, Send, Settings) working correctly. Public survey page at /survey/{token} fully functional with NPS selector, 6 category ratings, and thank you page.
critical_code_review_comments: All 10 survey API endpoints implemented and working correctly
Survey settings auto-create with 6 default categories (cleanliness, service, location, value, comfort, facilities)
Public survey endpoints (GET/POST /api/surveys/public/{token}) correctly require NO authentication
All other survey endpoints correctly require admin/manager role authentication
NPS scoring correctly categorizes: promoter (9-10), passive (7-8), detractor (0-6)
Low score alerts correctly logged to sync_logs when NPS <= threshold
Guest profiles correctly tagged with nps:promoter/passive/detractor when auto_tag_profiles enabled
Survey panel has 4 tabs: Analytics, Responses, Send, Settings - all working
Analytics shows 5 KPI cards: Net NPS Score, Avg NPS, Responses, Surveys Sent, Response Rate
Public survey page shows hotel name, NPS selector (0-10 with emoji), 6 category ratings, comment box
Thank you page displays after survey submission
Email sending uses Resend API with onboarding@resend.dev sender (real but sandbox)
WhatsApp survey delivery noted as not yet implemented in mocked_api info
